 SRI.AJITH VISWANATHAN, GP  THIS WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 07.08.2025, ALONG WITH WP(C).25668/2025, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 WP(C) Nos.25668/2025, 24582/2025 8 2025:KER:59183  JUDGMENT [WP(C) Nos.25668/2025 & 24582/2025] The petitioners in both these writ petitions are on a footing similar to the petitioners in WP(C) Nos.951/2025 and 1548/2025.
The facts are also similar.
The said two Writ Petitions were disposed of by this Court by judgment dated 3/6/2025.
The petitioners would seek similar treatment and similar course to be adopted in the instant two Writ Petitions as well.
2. Learned Government Pleader would not dispute the above submission, in view of the position settled by the judgment of this Court in the two Writ Petitions afore referred.

In the circumstances,
the District Collector will stand directed to adopt the same course as indicated in paragraph no.13 of the said judgment dated 3/6/2025 and to comply with the directions contained in paragraph no.14 therein, in the instant two writ petitions as well.

Needless to say, that the above WP(C)
Nos.25668/2025, 24582/2025 9 2025:KER:59183 course will be adopted expeditiously by the District Collector and preferably within a period of three months from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
These writ petitions are accordingly disposed of.
